subject: Launcher cohort: dual-sponsor credit stacking & packaging addendum
messages:
From: Hannah Cohen <hannah@launchforge.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@seedhub.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Launcher] co-sponsor credit consolidation and packaging ask

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick ask from our side: two of our cohort sponsors (LaunchForge and SeedHub) want to stack their complimentary Redwood credits for our June cohort to simplify onboarding for 12 teams. The sponsors each committed $25k in free credits and would like us to pool them into a single allocation per team rather than splitting across sponsor namespaces.

Questions:
- Is Redwood able to allow a one-time stacking exception so both sponsor credits are applied to the same project account?
- If so, can those credits be converted later into a discounted committed package (e.g., Dedicated trial or 3-month discounted commit) without additional manual approvals?

I attached a short sponsor term summary (Sponsor_Term_Summary.xlsx) showing timelines, seat counts, and the two sponsor contracts. We need a simple packaging path we can give to our procurement and legal folks (Samir CC'd).

Appreciate any guidance / guardrails — timeline is tight (teams start onboarding 7/10).

Best,
Hannah Cohen
Head of Programs — LaunchForge
hannah@launchforge.org

---
Attachment: Sponsor_Term_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cohen <hannah@launchforge.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir@seedhub.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Launcher] co-sponsor credit consolidation and packaging ask

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note and the attachment. Short answer: we can support a one-time stacking exception with a clear conversion path, but we need to document the packaging and billing flow up-front to avoid accounting friction later.

Proposed quick approach:
1) Allow pooling of both sponsor credit allocations into the Launcher cohort project (one-time exception).
2) Cap the stacking window to credits applied before 2027-08-31 to avoid lifetime entanglement.
3) Offer a conversion option: up to 60% of the pooled free credits can convert to a time-limited discounted commit (e.g., 3 months at 30% off) if the customer signs a simple addendum within 60 days after onboarding.

I CC'd Ben (pricing) and Laura (partnership ops) to iron out the exact numbers. Samir, once you confirm procurement cadence, we'll include a short addendum to the SOW and route a DocuSign link.

I'll draft the packaging addendum and SOW and share by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Launcher dual-sponsor ask — pricing/ops guardrails

Ben / Laura / Mateo —

Copy of external thread above. High level: LaunchForge + SeedHub want to pool $50k of sponsor credits for 12 teams and have a convertible path to a discounted committed package. Timeline: onboarding 7/10, conversion window requested within 60 days.

My recommended guardrails:
- One-time stacking exception for this cohort only. Mark as SponsorPool-2027-June in billing tags.
- Pool cap: $50,000 total free tokens. Per-team soft cap: $4,500 (12 teams).
- Conversion path: customer can elect to convert up to 60% of the pooled credits into a 3-month committed discount (30% off on token charges) via a short addendum. Conversion requires acceptance by sponsor owners where applicable (we'll include sign-off checkbox).
- Accounting: credits consumed are billed to a SponsorPool ledger; if converted, we will credit-invoice the agreed discount against future invoices. Mateo — can you confirm the ledger mapping and whether we need a separate SKU for converted-credit discounts?

Risks / notes:
- We must avoid double-counting credits back to sponsors. If sponsors need attribution for their budgets, include a Sponsor Attribution doc but keep billing to the pooled account.
- Legal: add clause limiting stacking to cohort start/end dates and forbidding resale. Laura — I can draft the addendum and SOW, want you to review for ops triggers.

Next steps: I will draft SOW addendum + DocuSign flow; target to send to Hannah + Samir by 7/1 EOD.

Thanks —
Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Hannah Cohen <hannah@launchforge.org>, Samir Gupta <samir@seedhub.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Launcher dual-sponsor ask — pricing/ops guardrails

Priyom / team —

I like the approach but recommend tightening the convertibility economics to protect unit economics. Counter-proposal:
- Allow stacking as proposed, but only up to $40k of the $50k pool to be eligible for conversion. The remaining $10k stays as non-convertible free uplift for teams (marketing/activation budget).
- Convertibility cap: 50% of eligible pool (so effectively 20k convertible). Conversion triggers a committed discount package: 3 months at 35% off with a minimum committed spend threshold of $8k/month.
- Add an administrative fee of $500 for the manual billing/ledger work — include on the first invoice.

If LaunchForge / SeedHub accept, we'll document in the SOW and HubSpot (DEAL-98765). This keeps us from turning promotional credits into a permanent revenue shortfall while still giving the customer a clear path.

If Laura and Mateo sign off on ledger / ops, I'll approve the addendum.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Pricing & Packaging — Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cohen <hannah@launchforge.org>, Samir Gupta <samir@seedhub.ai>

Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Launcher cohort — agreed exception and next steps (SOW addendum attached)

Hi Hannah / Samir —

Thanks for your patience. Quick summary of what we can do for the June cohort and the path to convert credits into a discounted pilot:

1) Stacking exception: Redwood will allow LaunchForge + SeedHub credits to be pooled into a single Launcher cohort project. Pool cap: $50,000.
2) Convertibility: up to $40,000 of the pool can be eligible for conversion. Conversion mechanics: customer may convert up to 50% of the eligible pool (so up to $20,000) into a 3-month committed discount (35% off) provided the customer signs the SOW addendum within 60 days of onboarding. Minimum committed spend to activate conversion: $8,000 / month.
3) Operational items: we will tag the pool as SponsorPool-2027-June in billing. A one-time administrative fee of $500 will be applied on the first invoice to cover ledger work.
4) Dates: stacking window closes 2027-08-31; onboarding as discussed week of 7/10.

I've attached the SOW addendum (SOW_Redwood_Launcher_v2.pdf) with redlines. Next steps: please confirm acceptance by replying "ACCEPT" and provide procurement contact for DocuSign. Samir — if this works for SeedHub, we can route the signature. Once we get an "ACCEPT", I'll push the DocuSign link and loop in operations to set the billing tag.

Thanks all — excited to get the cohort running.

Best,
Priyom Das
